content.short: Unimon is an NFT battle game that runs inside a Uniswap v4 hook on Unichain.
content.description: Unimon is an original NFT battle game managed entirely by a Uniswap v4 hook on Unichain. Players swap ETH into its pool to get eggs, hatch and level up monsters, then battle until the last ones standing split an ETH prize pool. Its contracts are open source, and Blockscout's Unichain marketplace lists it.
content.meta: Unimon is an NFT battle game built inside a Uniswap v4 hook, live on Unichain.
